title: WBCA Honors Its Veterans at Laredo's Veterans Day Parade
excerpt: The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association marched in Laredo's Veterans Day Parade on Nov. 11, honoring its president and board members who served in the U.S. military.
content:
The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association (WBCA) took part in Laredo's Veterans Day Parade on Tuesday, Nov. 11, joining the community in honoring the men and women who have served in the U.S. military.

The parade stepped off at 10 a.m. from Jarvis Plaza and marched down San Bernardo Avenue through downtown Laredo, ending at the Webb County Courthouse.

WBCA used the occasion to recognize its own veterans, including WBCA President Dr. Alberto Salinas, a U.S. Navy veteran, and members of its board and development team: Leo Rodriguez-Espinoza, a U.S. Army veteran; Dario Gutierrez, a U.S. Air Force veteran; and Jonathan Aaron Garza, a U.S. Navy veteran.

"Their courage, sacrifice, and unwavering dedication to protecting our freedoms will never be forgotten," WBCA said.

Source: Washington's Birthday Celebration Association (Facebook), Nov. 11, 2026.
